desc: A light pair of boots that allow for swift movements when wading through snow and blizzards. You can scout the frozen fringes of the mountains for miles when wearing these shoes!
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x2、硬化皮革 x6、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: A blue overcoat with a fluffy, snow-white trim to keep warm. The pelts are lightweight and won't weigh you down when scaling the mountain tops to find vantage points.
ingredients_zh: 紫水晶 x5、保暖衬垫 x2、钢锭 x1、硬化皮革 x8、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: A pair of thick gloves, stuffed with warm, white fur. The area around the back of the wrist is shielded with a small metal plate.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x3、硬化皮革 x4、甲壳粉 x25

desc: A fur hood that protects the wearer's face from the strong, cutting mountain winds.
ingredients_zh: 黑曜石 x1、保暖衬垫 x2、硬化皮革 x2、甲壳粉 x25

desc: A simple pair of brown leather pants that connect well to the corresponding undergarments for the torso.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x5、硬化皮革 x8、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: Woodland boots made of carefully layered leather straps.
The leather on this nature-bound armor piece was layered to resemble the leaves of a blossoming forest.
These Archer Gloves have been refined to be snug and effective.
An archer's hood. The leather trim provides additional protection and camouflages the wearer between the trees.
The coloring of these pants allows the wearer to seamlessly blend into the foliage.
Your steps will be quick and quiet, and your strikes will be deadly.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x1、黄色布料 x1、皮革 x2、堕落之心 x1

desc: A refined chest piece that lets you fade into the dark and strike from the shadows.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x4、黄色布料 x4、鳞片 x15、堕落之心 x1

desc: Robust gloves that hide the wearer's palms and true intentions.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x2、黄色布料 x2、鳞片 x6、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x2

desc: A special piece of cloth was added to this assassin hood to hide the wearer's face and their most likely daunting smile.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x1、黄色布料 x2、鳞片 x10、堕落之心 x1

desc: A plain pair of pants. Under different circumstances, they would allow the wearer to easily blend into any crowd.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x2、黄色布料 x3、鳞片 x14、易碎瘴气薄片 x25

desc: With this chest piece, you can cut through the woods with ease, remaining undetected as you prepare your next strike.
Adorned with a crystal and gold trip, these gloves give you a firm grip on your daggers - ideal for strikes from behind.
The head armor combines a mask, cloth, and horns. For most foes, it will be the last thing they see when you catch them by surprise.
Designed for stealth, these natural pants make sneaking through the thicket effortless.
With these shoes, maintain your stance and recover before launching your next attack.
These boots are perfect for keeping a stable stance while aiming, shooting, and killing.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x2、黄色布料 x1、鳞片 x4、堕落之心 x3

desc: Your shots will always find their mark with these gloves.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x2、黄色布料 x2、鳞片 x10、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x2

desc: This archery hood lets you watch over the peaks and valleys like a hawk. Nothing will escape your vigilant gaze !
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x1、黄色布料 x1、鳞片 x5、堕落之心 x3

desc: These pants are extremely light and therefore enable quick and flexible movements. Crouch, climb, and run to gain an advantage !
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x4、黄色布料 x4、鳞片 x15、雾霭沙 x25

desc: Duck, dodge, and roll out of harm's way with this lightweight vest.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x4、黄色布料 x4、鳞片 x20、堕落之心 x4

desc: Stalking prey in these boots makes barely any sound. None will hear you coming.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x2、皮革 x6、堕落之心 x3

desc: Every movement is softened and muted whilst clad in this upper body armor.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x2、衬垫 x2、鳞片 x25、皮革 x1、堕落之心 x4

desc: Firing an arrow with these gloves is effortless, creating a silky smooth stream of movement for the wearer.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x3、鳞片 x10、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x2

desc: The cloth straps attached to this mask glide softly in the breeze, helping to discern wind direction and speed.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x1、衬垫 x2、鳞片 x10、堕落之心 x3

desc: Warm and padded hunting pants that will retain your body heat during cold, starless nights.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x5、鳞片 x20、雾霭沙 x25

desc: Wrapped in darkened leather and shrouded in mystery, these boots carry the wearer as if on clouds.
The bright adornment on this armor piece shines brightly and aims to honor the glorious Flame.
Blessed by the Flame and bathed in the glorious light, these gloves will ensure that your every strike is guided by the Ancients themselves.
This hood further enhances your sight and lets your gaze burn hotter than a thousand suns.
The faded cool hue of these pants provides stark contrast to the flaming accents on the rest of the armor set.
Wearing these boots makes each step feel like you're being carried on silver wings
The details on this piece of upper body armor were greatly inspired by wing feathers.
These improved archery gloves make it easier to shoot birds out of the sky ! There are hardly any birds these days, though.
Remain keen - eyed as a hawk with this eerie hood.
Green pants which allow the wearer to glide through tall grass swiftly and silently.
Heavy boots with metal caps, perfect for kicking down doors or crushing skulls under your heel.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x1、紫罗兰布料 x1、皮革 x2、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: A breezy west layered on top of a long shirt. The additional belt buckle strapped across the chest holds some spare blades.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x4、紫罗兰布料 x4、银锭 x5、木炭 x3、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: Padded gloves made from thick white cloth and deep blue leather arm guards. A small buckle and cyan string hold them together. The fingertips are left bare, so you can still feel the pulse of the hunt.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x2、紫罗兰布料 x2、银锭 x3、甲壳粉 x25

desc: The fearsome metal mask is only partially covered by the hood, leaving most of its sharp edges and lines visible to your prey.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x1、紫罗兰布料 x2、银锭 x1、雾锁独眼巨人之眼 x1

desc: This pair of pants has ample space for carrying exposed blades and hidden toxins.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x2、紫罗兰布料 x3、银锭 x3、木炭 x2、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: Ride as swift as the bluejays with these sturdy leather boots.
A formidable chest piece, decorated with many elements resembling nature, vines and petals
Reliable gloves which shield the wearer's arms from claws.
This hood includes an iron facemask which was greatly inspired by owls.
Pants such as these were originally made fashionable by prominent falconers from ages long past.
These boots are ideal for stalking prey.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x10、皮革 x6、树脂 x6、腐蚀之血 x3

desc: These leather gloves have been adorned with metal to protect the weaver's knuckles.
ingredients_zh: 薄荷蘑菇肉 x6、皮革 x7、树脂 x5、琥珀 x4、氨腺 x3

desc: Remain unseen and strike from the shadows with this formidable archer's hood.
ingredients_zh: 化石骨粉末 x3、皮革 x4、树脂 x3、薄荷蘑菇肉 x4、小动物腺体 x6

desc: Nothing is more suitable for a long prowl than this set of pants.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x8、皮革 x10、薄荷蘑菇肉 x6、树脂 x4、石化瘴气潜行者壳 x2

desc: Taking down prey, and even other predators, is far easier with this finely made hunter's armor.
ingredients_zh: 皮革 x12、化石骨 x5、树脂 x8、薄荷蘑菇肉 x8、迷雾粘合剂 x9

desc: The Reinforced soles allow the wearer to skulk through mud undisturbed, and to reach vantage points quickly. Perfect for an ambush!
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x8、植物纤维 x2、干燥毛皮 x2、易碎瘴气花瓣 x5

desc: These gloves prevent the bowstring from digging into the skin while lining up shots.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x2、干燥毛皮 x3、植物纤维 x2、易碎瘴气花瓣 x3

desc: A darkened hood which lets you blend into the woodland scenery more easily. A piece of red cloth covers the mouth, making you feel like a bandit.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x2、树枝 x1、干燥毛皮 x2、植物纤维 x3、腐化野猪獠牙 x1

desc: The added leather grants superior protection from jagged rocks, unruly tree bark, and incoming arrows.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x5、植物纤维 x3、干燥毛皮 x4、雾瘴蘑菇 x5

desc: A warm, padded vest. Ideal for enduring cold nights while awaiting the time to strike.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x4、植物纤维 x5、干燥毛皮 x5、树枝 x2、巨型生物鳞片 x3

desc:
These boots are always damp, even on the inside. Walking in them feels like wading through a bog.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x4、巨兽肋骨 x1、皮革 x5

desc:
Countless cankerous growths sprout from this leather armour, thus forging it in a new image.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x6、巨兽肋骨 x2、皮革 x6、青铜锭 x6

desc: These traditional archer gloves were made asymmetrical through multiple monstrous tusks and bone shards jutting outwards.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x5、巨兽肋骨 x2、皮革 x5

desc:
Putrescence laps the side of this brown hood, like a wave of pestilence crashing to shore.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x3、巨兽肋骨 x1、青铜锭 x2、皮革 x2

desc:
Leather pants with noticeable grain that morphs into fine fungal tendrils.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x4、巨兽肋骨 x2、皮革 x3、青铜锭 x2、亚麻布 x5

desc: As Quetzals no longer roam Embervale, dyed palm laves are used in place of their feathers to recreate the look.
ingredients_zh: 橙色布料 x2、水豚鬃毛 x4、粉色蘑菇肉 x50、水爬虫皮革 x5、迸裂荒野之心 x1

desc: These gauntlets shield your arms as you chase through the undergrowth, striking foes from afar.
ingredients_zh: 鱼类象牙粉尘 x2、微光根粉尘 x10、水豚鬃毛 x2、海蓝宝石 x4、被诅咒的迷雾囊 x1

desc: Inspired by the Quetzal, a magnificent bird that once graced the skies of Embervale, this beautiful armor set lets you feel the freedom and precision of flight when you wear it.
ingredients_zh: 海蓝宝石 x2、水豚鬃毛 x1、棕榈叶 x5、甲壳粉 x1

desc: They let you sprint through the thicket with the swiftness of wings.
ingredients_zh: 水爬虫皮革 x3、水豚鬃毛 x4、棕榈叶 x5、粉色蘑菇肉 x50、腐化野猪獠牙 x1

desc: In these shoes, you glide through the thicket effortlessly, barely breaking a sweat.
ingredients_zh: 鱼类象牙粉尘 x2、水豚鬃毛 x2、粉色蘑菇肉 x50、雾霭污泥 x1

desc: These boots were made for those wishing to lurk quietly through the thicket.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x8、爬行动物皮革 x2、易碎瘴气花瓣 x5

desc: Simple gloves made from ethically sourced organic leather.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x2、爬行动物皮革 x3、骨头 x2、雾霭囊 x1

desc: A hood that provides additional protection from the sun, allowing you to focus your gaze undisturbed.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x1、骨头 x1、爬行动物皮革 x1、树脂 x1、易碎瘴气花瓣 x1

desc: Pants which shield the legs from brambles and thorns while hunting down prey.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x3、骨头 x3、爬行动物皮革 x2、雾瘴蘑菇 x5

desc: This piece of armor only offers minor protection against incoming arrows, but that hardly matters. The best preventative measure is to aim for the eyes.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x5、爬行动物皮革 x5、铜锭 x1、木炭 x1、琥珀 x2、巨型生物鳞片 x3

desc: The path of the scout is a little easier on quiet soles.
ingredients_zh: 细线 x8、干燥毛皮 x4、树脂 x2、菌丝体（材料） x15

desc: A simple, light chest piece to complement the rest of the armor.
ingredients_zh: 细线 x6、干燥毛皮 x5、骨头 x6、活性菌丝 x25

desc: Excellent tools to scout with - especially due to their grip and padding.
ingredients_zh: 骨头 x2、细线 x2、干燥毛皮 x2、充气女妖凝胶 x1

desc: The perfect disguise - even in broad daylight.
ingredients_zh: 细线 x1、干燥毛皮 x1、骨头 x1、充气女妖凝胶 x1

desc: Silent pants to tread quietly.
ingredients_zh: 细线 x4、干燥毛皮 x4、骨头 x4、雾瘴液体 x5

desc: With these weighted soles, even shaky or uneven ground will not disturb your aim.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x10、皮革 x6、薄荷蘑菇肉 x2、树脂 x6、腐蚀之血 x3

desc: Wearing these gloves makes the pulse slow down mysteriously before going in for the kill, thus steadying the hands.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x3、皮革 x3、靛蓝植物 x1、稻草 x2、薄荷蘑菇肉 x2、氨腺 x3

desc: The metal adorment on this hood faintly resembles the beak of a hawk.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x3、皮革 x4、薄荷蘑菇肉 x2、靛蓝植物 x1、稻草 x1、雾瘴凝胶 x3

desc: The pants were made from varied materials and protect all the most important areas adequately.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x3、皮革 x4、薄荷蘑菇肉 x2、靛蓝植物 x1、稻草 x2、氨腺 x3

desc: The shoulder pads on this Sharpshooter Vest are exceptionally sharp and pointed like the tip of an arrow.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x4、皮革 x6、薄荷蘑菇肉 x2、靛蓝植物 x1、稻草 x3、迷雾粘合剂 x9

desc: You feel calm and guarded in this upper body armor - consider your next move carefully.
ingredients_zh: 棕榈叶 x4、水豚鬃毛 x4、水爬虫皮革 x5、黑曜石 x50、迸裂荒野之心 x1

desc: These gloves lock your hold on the bow - target the head with steady aim.
ingredients_zh: 鱼骨 x2、水豚鬃毛 x2、微光根粉尘 x10、水爬虫皮革 x2、被诅咒的迷雾囊 x1

desc: Pierce your foes through the heart - using your horns isn't necessary.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x1、黑曜石 x5、鱼牙 x2、甲壳粉 x1

desc: These pants move with you through the underbrush, boosting your stamina as you stalk your prey.
ingredients_zh: 绿矾粉尘 x4、水爬虫皮革 x3、水豚鬃毛 x4、粉色蘑菇肉 x50、腐化野猪獠牙 x1

desc: Seamlessly matching the rest of your outfit, these shoes let nothing stand between you and your goal.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x2、粉色蘑菇肉 x50、水爬虫皮革 x5、雾霭污泥 x1

desc: These heavy boots provide excellent resistance and enable a stronger stance when facing various behemoths.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x2、硬化皮革 x5、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: This armor piece was made from a combination of soft materials and hard, scale-like plating to ensure the ultimate flow of movement and protection. It has small hunting trophies attached to various spaces.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x4、硬化皮革 x5、紫水晶 x4、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: Sturdy gloves, dark as the midnight sky. They've been adorned with animal horns that were gathered during the hunt.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x2、紫水晶 x2、硬化皮革 x2、甲壳粉 x25

desc: The metal rim around this hood forms an elegant crown, jagging out from the wearer's skull. The shape of the tips is reminiscent of wings.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x2、硬化皮革 x1、紫水晶 x1、甲壳粉 x25

desc: Pants made from deep blue cloth and patched leather. The layers on the inside provide good insulation against the bitter cold.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x4、紫水晶 x4、硬化皮革 x3、雾锁之冰 x50
